description: Composite 3 × 4 montage of twelve TEM images tracking the deformation substructure of 2Ni steel at increasing engineering strain, each panel corner-labelled: (a,b) 5%, (c–g) 10%, (h–l) LD (close to final failure). Seven panels (a–c, e–g, j) carry selected-area electron diffraction insets indexed on the [011] zone axis with 111, 1-11, 200 and 000 reflections. Scale bars are printed in every panel: 500 nm in (a–g), 200 nm in (h,i), 100 nm in (j,k), 10 nm in (l). (a,b) are bright-field images showing slip bands only, with white annotation lines and a bent bracket labelled "(111)trace" plus the text "Slip band" in (b); (c) shows dense parallel slip bands with a "(111)trace" line; (d) is a black-background image with one bright "(111)trace"; (e,f) show crossing "(111)trace" bands; (g) shows three intersecting traces labelled "(111)trace", "(111)trace" and "(200)trace". At LD, (h) is a dark speckled image labelled "Dislocation"; (i) shows a "Very fine slip band" and a "(111)trace"; (j) is labelled "Stacking fault" and carries the SAED inset; (k) is a dark-field image with a white circle; (l) is the 10 nm high-resolution image of that circled region. Together they show strain-driven multiplication and refinement of planar slip bands culminating in high dislocation density, fine slip bands and stacking faults, with no deformation twins.

observations.observation: The figure is a 3 × 4 montage of twelve TEM panels of 2Ni steel, each labelled in its corner with the engineering strain: (a,b) 5%, (c–g) 10%, (h–l) LD.
Scale bars are printed in every panel: 500 nm in (a–g), 200 nm in (h,i), 100 nm in (j,k) and 10 nm in (l).
Selected-area electron diffraction insets appear in panels (a), (b), (c), (e), (f), (g) and (j), all indexed on the [011] zone axis with reflections marked 111, 1-11, 200 and 000.
Panel (g) shows three intersecting slip-band traces annotated with the plane indices '(111)trace', '(111)trace' and '(200)trace'.

At the LD condition, panel (h) is labelled 'Dislocation', panel (i) carries the annotation 'Very fine slip band', panel (j) is labelled 'Stacking fault', panel (k) is a dark-field image with a white circle, and panel (l) is a 10 nm high-resolution image.
Panels (d), (h) and (k) have black backgrounds with bright features, i.e. dark-field-type imaging, whereas (a), (b), (c), (e), (f), (g), (i) and (j) are bright-field-type images.
The caption states the TEM images show microstructural evolution of 2Ni steel at 5%, 10% and close to final failure (LD) engineering strains.
The citing text states that deformation of 2Ni steel is primarily dominated by planar slip, with slip bands the only feature at 5% strain (Fig. 7a,b).
The citing text assigns (1-11) slip bands to Fig. 7a and reports slip bands on the (−111) slip plane intercepted by slip bands on the (1-11) slip plane in Fig. 7b.
The citing text states that at 10% strain three groups of slip systems form — [011](1-11), [011](−111) and [011](200) — as shown in Fig. 7g.

The citing text reports that near fracture (LD) high-density dislocations (Fig. 7h) and very fine slip bands (Fig. 7i) occur, and that stacking faults were found in bright-field (Fig. 7j), dark-field (Fig. 7k) and high-resolution (Fig. 7l) images, but no deformation twins were detected.
The citing text states that panel (l) is the high-resolution TEM image of the circled portion of panel (k).
